routing.instructions: Route this logistics exception to the desk that should handle it. Choose exactly one desk. Rule: if the request shows at least two contract-abuse warning signs (no supporting documents, a contract signed less than 30 days before the request, or a claimed amount over USD 18,500), route to contract compliance regardless of incident type.

criteria.damage_desk: Physical damage: crush, water, temperature, handling accidents.
criteria.loss_desk: Missing or misdelivered goods, seal and shortage cases.
criteria.customs_desk: Customs holds, duty reclassification, penalties, bonded transfers.
criteria.carrier_relations: Carrier performance: late pickups, breakdowns, wrong equipment.
criteria.contract_compliance: Requests with repeated contract-abuse warning signs.

contract_abuse_review.instructions: Should this request be flagged for contract-compliance review before any recovery is pursued? Answer yes only when at least two warning signs appear: no supporting documents, a contract signed within 30 days of the request, or a claimed amount over USD 18,500.

urgency.instructions: How urgently must this exception be worked? critical: pharmaceutical cargo or dangerous (ADR) goods affected. urgent: goods missing, held, misrouted or vanished. priority: customs matters or a claim over USD 8,800. routine: everything else.

liability_eligibility.instructions: Is the loss covered by the contract? Rules: the incident must fall on or after the contract signing date. An incident within 2 days after signing needs manual review. Temperature-excision guarantees (pharma reefer cover) apply only on Plus or Premium service tiers. Otherwise the loss is covered.

criteria.covered: Contract active for the incident and the service is included.
criteria.not_covered_contract_not_active: The incident happened before the contract was signed.
criteria.review_required_fresh_contract: Incident within 2 days of signing; review first.

recovery_band.instructions: After the contractual deductible (liability waiver) is applied, which band does the recoverable amount fall into? Waivers: damage USD 400, loss USD 600, customs USD 150, carrier relations USD 200. If the loss is not covered or is held for compliance review, nothing is recoverable yet (USD 0).

criteria.zero_nothing_recoverable: Not covered, needs review, or held for compliance.
criteria.over_15000: Recoverable over USD 15,000 after the waiver.

subcarrier_recovery.instructions: Should the loss be recovered from a sub-carrier or dock partner? Answer yes only when a specific third party is identified: a subcontracted carrier that admitted fault in writing, or a shortage recorded by the receiving dock team with the receiving report attached.

expected_touches.instructions: How many handler touches will this exception need? 0-1: complete, documented, low-value request (straight-through candidate). 2: one complication - missing documents, a claim over USD 8,800, or a liability check. 3: two complications. 4+: flagged for compliance review or three complications.
